name: Bartender
description: Bartender is a macOS menu bar manager for organizing, hiding, finding and activating menu bar items with layouts, presets, triggers and widgets.
agentUseSummary: Bartender is visible as a supported-interface review preview. Relay will not simulate menu-bar clicks or inherit Bartender's Screen Recording and Accessibility authority without a documented external API and a narrow local permission boundary.

capabilities.label: Manage approved menu bar layouts
capabilities.description: If Bartender documents a supported external interface, manage only explicitly approved presets or typed menu bar items on the connected Mac.

blocked.label: Control Bartender from Railway
blocked.description: Bartender manages device-local menu bar state; Relay will not invent a cloud API or export Mac accessibility authority to Railway.

blocked.label: Simulate Bartender or menu bar interaction
blocked.description: Relay will not use mouse, keyboard, Accessibility or screen-image scripting as a substitute for a documented provider interface.

blocked.label: Activate an arbitrary menu bar item
blocked.description: Menu bar items belong to unrelated applications and may expose sensitive or destructive commands that Bartender does not type for Relay.

blocked.label: Run actions before a supported interface exists
blocked.description: No list, reveal, activate, preset, trigger or widget action is callable until Bartender documents a stable external interface and Relay can constrain its exact local effects.

approvalProfiles.label: Supported interface review required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and execution remain unavailable because Bartender's current official materials do not document an external API suitable for Relay and the app holds sensitive macOS permissions.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tool is callable without a documented Bartender external interface and hardened Mac-local permission boundary.
No Hermes tool is callable without a documented Bartender external interface and hardened Mac-local permission boundary.

providerSetup.blocker: Bartender's current official product and support materials document user-facing presets, triggers, widgets and sensitive Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions, but no stable external API suitable for Relay.
providerSetup.nextAction: Obtain a documented provider-supported interface, then design a Mac-local adapter with item and preset identifiers, read-versus-activate separation, explicit approval for cross-app activation, TCC minimization, auditing and revocation. Do not substitute UI scripting.

evidence.supports: Bartender documents local menu bar layouts, groups, presets, triggers, Quick Search activation and beta widgets that can trigger actions.
Bartender's official support page documents local installation, item indexing, mouse movement and required Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions.
Bartender's permission guide identifies the ScreenCapture and Accessibility TCC authorities required by the direct and Setapp app variants.
Current release notes document image capture, item indexing and identity, mouse-driven moves, item clicks and automatic trigger behavior; they do not publish an external Relay-suitable API.
